item_name: Rothco Distressed U.S. Flag Canvas Messenger Bag
item_short_desc: Proudly display your support for the United States with Rothco’s Distressed U.S. Flag Canvas Messenger Bag.
description: Proudly display your support for the United States with Rothco’s Distressed U.S. Flag Canvas Messenger Bag. The messenger bag’s design features unwashed double-stitched heavyweight cotton canvas material, brass hardware, and a large horizontal distressed red, white, and blue U.S. flag on the hook and loop flap closure. Measuring 15" X 11" X 6", the main compartment provides a vast amount of storage space for your books, folders, a small laptop, and other essential items. Additional gear can be stored in the two open-top front pockets, snap button side pockets, and the interior zippered pocket. The flap closure features two canvas loops on the front for added gear attachment. Carry the military messenger bag as a shoulder bag or cross body bag with the adjustable shoulder strap (extends to 52”). Rothco’s American flag messenger bag is perfect for military personnel, students, or travelers looking for a convenient and versatile shoulder bag to carry all the gear they need.
